question: What follows from falling into doubt between two views?
premises: one who falls into doubt certainly may go to loss of both
this occurs in own view and other view
inference: doubt between views leads to loss of both when agreement is transgressed
uncertainties: ubhayabhraṣṭatāṃ may mean ruin of both paths
plain_english: Certainly, one who has fallen into doubt may go to loss of both, in his own view and in the other's view, from transgressing agreement.
